newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wah Nam realizes loss in property sale.
newsitem.headline: Wah Nam realizes loss in property sale.

text.p: Wah Nam Group Ltd said on Tuesday it would realize a loss of about HK$11.8 million on disposal of a property at Mid-levels on Hong Kong Island.
Wah Nam Group said its 80-percent owned On Yuen Development Ltd had agreed to sell the Mid-levels property, Nikken Heights, to a third party Max City Ltd for HK$203 million.
Nikken Heights comprises 42 residential units with total gross floor area of 42,130 square feet in a 23-storey building.
Wah Nam Group said it effectively acquired the property when it bought an 80 percent stake in On Yuen in July 1994. The property was valued at HK$245 million at that time, it said.
The company said the property was valued at HK$210 million as at January 13, 1997.
Wah Nam Group said the disposal would improve the working capital of the company and reduce interest payments.
Of the net proceeds of about HK$200 million, HK$131 million will be used to repay shareholders loans and the balance will retain for future investment purposes, it said.
Trading of the company shares, which was suspended on January 17, resumes on Tuesday.

Wah Nam Group is an investment holding company with subsidiaries engaging in the making of consumer electronic and electrical products, plastic and electrical goods and ceramics tiles, property investment and construction and administration of infrastructure projects.
